sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 6815 of 2024

Petitioner :- Sanjay Kumar Pandey And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Abhinandan Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State/opposite parties and perused the record.

This petition seeks issuance of direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned F.I.R.
dated 16.07.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0632/2024, for the offence under Sections 420,406,504,506,120-B & 34 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District- Barabanki.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the offences as alleged in FIR have maximum punishment for the term less than seven years imprisonment, whereas, the police is trying to arrest them, which is against the mandates of Code of Criminal Procedure.
